item.title: All-Inclusive Adoptions start 1/1/20! - The Humane Society of Warren County
item.description: Starting January first, the Humane Society of Warren County is transition to All-inclusive adoptions, which means that all animals will be spayed or neutered, microchipped, combo tested and vaccinated before the time of adoption.
